name: fix_python_subprocess_shell_injection
description: subprocess.run(f-string, shell=True) command injection -> list args without a shell; incomplete-fix broken wraps names in single quotes but keeps the shell
prompts: make_thumbnail in thumbs.py builds its ImageMagick command by f-string interpolation and runs it with shell=True - a filename like photo'; rm -rf ~; echo '.png executes arbitrary commands. Fix it properly: pass the command as an argument LIST (['convert', src, '-thumbnail', size, dest]) with NO shell, so any filename - quotes, semicolons, spaces and all - arrives at convert as a single argv element. Do not try to quote or escape the interpolated string instead; keep check=True and the function's signature and default size.

setup_files.thumbs.py:
import subprocess


def make_thumbnail(src, dest, size="128x128"):
    """Shell out to ImageMagick to render a thumbnail."""
    cmd = f"convert {src} -thumbnail {size} {dest}"
    subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, check=True)

test_setup_files.test_thumbs_hidden.py:
import subprocess

import thumbs


class RunRecorder:
    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []

    def __call__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        self.calls.append((args, kwargs))

        class Done:
            returncode = 0

        return Done()


def test_hostile_filename_stays_one_argument(monkeypatch):
    rec = RunRecorder()
    monkeypatch.setattr(thumbs.subprocess, "run", rec)

    hostile = "photo'; rm -rf ~; echo '.png"
    thumbs.make_thumbnail(hostile, "out.png")

    assert len(rec.calls) == 1
    (cmd,), kwargs = rec.calls[0][0][:1], rec.calls[0][1]
    assert isinstance(cmd, (list, tuple)), (
        f"the command must be an argument LIST, not a shell string: {cmd!r}")
    assert not kwargs.get("shell"), "shell=True must be gone"
    assert list(cmd) == ["convert", hostile, "-thumbnail", "128x128", "out.png"], (
        f"the hostile filename must arrive as ONE argv element, got {cmd!r}")


def test_normal_call_shape(monkeypatch):
    rec = RunRecorder()
    monkeypatch.setattr(thumbs.subprocess, "run", rec)

    thumbs.make_thumbnail("in.jpg", "small.jpg", size="64x64")

    (cmd,), kwargs = rec.calls[0][0][:1], rec.calls[0][1]
    assert list(cmd) == ["convert", "in.jpg", "-thumbnail", "64x64", "small.jpg"]
    assert kwargs.get("check") is True, "check=True must be preserved"
